items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Because I met him through his trombone player.

ctx.x: He cannot improvise. Because I met him through his trombone player. I knew him... He says, "Herb thinks he can, but he can't improvise. He'd like to." But he's a studio man. He can read.
George Foster and Tudie Garland, what was the difference with them? Who did you like to work with?
